c2-chain.title: Four-Clause Fluency
c2-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + بس/و + نتيجة + و + تفصيل إضافي
c2-chain.explanation: This is the top of the course: sentences that pack four full clauses together the way a fluent speaker actually talks -- a statement, its reason, a contrast or addition, and one more detail, all in a single breath: بشوف بيت جديد اليوم لأن هاد قديم كتير، بس عندي فلوس منيح، وبدي بشوف بكرة كمان (I'm seeing a new house today because this one is very old, but I have good money, and I want to see one tomorrow too). Nothing here is new grammar -- it's the same simple pieces from the whole course, just chained at native speed.
c2-chain.fact: Reaching this level means you can follow (and produce) Syrian Arabic the way it's actually spoken in a real conversation -- not textbook sentences, but the long, looping, reason-then-detail style that native speakers use without even thinking about it.
